info.prompt: A cybernetic cathedral pulsates with neon cyan and electric magenta veins, its skeletal gold filigree arches framing a 60-tile game board where twelve sealed tiles glow with intensifying radiance—each etched with cryptic condition icons that fracture open in particle bursts upon unlock, revealing shimmering multipliers amidst a backdrop of void black depth, terminal-style hacker text scrolling vertically along the edges like a live system override, while rhythmic waveforms throb in sync with 120 BPM markers streaking toward the hit zone.
